text:
maria: Quick summary from today's probe: prototyped a coarse->fine speculative gate for a 13B quant candidate. Latency wins but QA EM dropped on our NaturalQA slice.

kai: what was the gate?

maria: run cheap proposal model (4-bit tiny-q) to emit tokens; accept token if entropy <= 0.5 else fallback to full model. Command: `rundec --proposal tiny-q4 --target llama3-13b --accept-ent 0.5 --run qc_9303`.

james: perf?

maria: median token latency ~ -25%, p95 -13%, throughput +32%, est per-token cost -19%. But EM down ~3.2 pts; accept-error-rate ~0.8% (coarse wrongly accepted early).

laura: likely calibration shift from quantization (logits too sharp).

maria: tried temperature scaling (tau=1.2) and a tiny verifier rerank (distil-qa) on accepted spans. Temp helped a bit; verifier recovered ~2.5 EM at +4% cost.

kai: plan: (1) threshold sweep 0.35->0.75, (2) tau sweep 0.8->1.5, (3) small ensemble of two q4 variants, (4) top2-gap rule, (5) run with KV-cache on/off. Each cell x3 seeds.

james: log logits, seeds, model git sha. Use scripts/align_tokens.py to avoid shift miscounts.

maria: uploading per-example CSV and failure traces to s3://redwood-experiments/quant-gates/qc_9303/. ops-bot: canary qc_9303 launched on dedicated-pool-4.

ops-bot: canary qc_9303 (8 reps) started :rocket:

laura: also test percentile-adaptive threshold (per-prefix median) and adversarial QA prompts.

maria: will post sweep plots and a short set of hand-inspected failures tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:
